$comment: Declared preferred main/sub-agent models and effort levels per runtime target. GENERATOR-CONSUMED entries: targets.opencode (scripts/generate_opencode_plugin.py, scripts/generate_opencode_agents.py) and targets.cursor.subagent (scripts/generate_cursor_agents.py). The Claude and Codex entries are DOCUMENTATION of values maintained directly in their native config files (ycc/settings/settings.json and .codex-plugin/config/config.toml), because those files are user-editable configs rather than generated artifacts; scripts/validate-model-settings.sh checks that they stay consistent with this file. opencode and cursor values are placeholders (placeholder: true): the usable catalog depends on the provider subscriptions and plan each machine has, and Cursor additionally gates subagent models by plan/admin policy.
